name: orders-service
description: Owns checkout and order history, backed by an in-memory store with no database. Checkout turns the caller's cart into an order, simulating payment (no real payment gateway is called) and reserving stock; every read is scoped to the caller's own orders under /me. Does not manage cart contents or stock levels directly — it calls cart-service and inventory-service for those.

dependencies.name: cart-service
dependencies.description: Reads the caller's cart contents to build the order at checkout, then clears the cart.

dependencies.name: inventory-service
dependencies.description: Reserves stock for each line item at checkout and releases it if checkout fails.

dependencies.name: customers-service
dependencies.description: Reads the caller's default shipping address to attach to the order.

dependencies.name: notifications-service
dependencies.description: Creates an in-app notification whenever an order's status changes.
